text:
mina: quick note — saw flaky SSE chunk ordering in the new onboarding sample. after auth refresh the stream sometimes shows fragments out of order and tiny duplicates. reproduced with network toggle in Chrome devtools.
mina: raw-ish log: 
```
[2027-01-12T11:05:21.100Z] conn open id=sess-77
[2027-01-12T11:05:21.220Z] sse id=201 data=\"{\\\"t\\\":\\\"Hello \\\"\"\n[2027-01-12T11:05:21.300Z] client reset: ECONNABORTED
[2027-01-12T11:05:21.420Z] reconnect resume_id=sess-77 last_id=201
[2027-01-12T11:05:21.530Z] sse id=203 data=\"...world\\\"\n[2027-01-12T11:05:21.610Z] sse id=202 data=\"...lo \"\n[2027-01-12T11:05:21.700Z] sse id=203 data=\"...world\\\" (dup)
```
mina: sample-app uses browser-sdk v0.9.8 and a tiny fetch wrapper: 
```
const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while(true){ const {done, value} = await reader.read(); if(done) break; onData(value); }
```
jon: thanks — two quick q's: 1) does the runtime always emit an `id:` per logical fragment? 2) are you using a local proxy (nginx/envoy/http-proxy-middleware)?
mina: yes id per fragment. local dev uses http-proxy-middleware -> staging. i captured a tcp trace and it looks like server wrote to two sockets around the reconnect window.
tara: likely causes: auth refresh triggers a new connection before old socket fully drains; runtime may replay tail to new socket while old socket still receives buffered writes. proxy can also obscure the drain behavior.
jon: client-side mitigations we should standardize in the SDK: 1) persist last-seen `id` and send `Last-Event-ID` header on reconnect, 2) dedupe by (id + small hash) in an LRU, 3) apply a small reorder window (buffer by id with 250-500ms flush) and emit telemetry when reordering occurs.
mina: implemented a local patch with LRU(128) and Last-Event-ID and it cuts duplicates by ~90% but occasional seq jumps still reorder.
tara: infra follow-up: we should add server-side guardrails so when a resume is detected we mark the old connection as read-only and stop writing duplicate chunks to it. also check proxy connection draining settings for http-proxy-middleware.
jon: SDK proposal: opt-in flag `streaming.resumeMode = \"robust\"` that does Last-Event-ID, dedupe, reorder buffer, and jittered reconnect backoff. default stays current behavior for backwards compat.
mina: can we also have the SDK emit a small metric/event when it sees duplicate ids or out-of-order ids? that would help correlate customer reports with infra traces.
tara: yes — infra and runtime can pick up the metric and tie it to tcp captures. i'll file an infra ticket and attach your tcp trace + proxy config.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1297: \"SSE resume duplicate emission guard + proxy drain checks\" and attached artifacts.
mina: thanks — i'll open a PR in sample-app to enable the `robust` flag behind a beta toggle and include a minimal reproducer.
jon: perfect. let's keep this small and opt-in until we validate across proxies. downstream: plan a follow-up to bake dedupe+resume into the official SDK in the next minor release. :thumbsup:
